simultaneous_operation_table.condition: timer expiry and one or more eligible external irq bits are sampled on the same rising edge
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: All eligible source bits are merged into the pending set; no source update overwrites another.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: a retained source is pending and a different eligible source is sampled before the first is serviced
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: Both distinct source bits remain represented as pending.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: the same source is sampled repeatedly before service
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: The pending representation remains a single set bit; no event-counting behavior is required.

simultaneous_operation_table.condition: resetn is sampled low on an edge that also presents interrupt events
simultaneous_operation_table.required_effect: Reset wins and those events are not retained across reset.
